heading: Dashboard
pollTooltip: One setting for the whole page: tiles, server list and the "Total load" chart below are polled at this interval. Less often means less load on the panel and on the network to managed hosts.

serversOnline.label: Servers online
serversOnline.tooltip: A server is considered online if at least one VPN provider installed on it is currently active (interface is up)

peersOnline.label: Clients online
peersOnline.tooltip: A client is considered online if it had a recent handshake (for WireGuard/AmneziaWG) or has an active session

totalRx.label: Total received
totalRx.tooltip: Sum of traffic across all active VPN interfaces on all servers in the panel — the panel itself doesn't generate traffic, it only reads counters from the managed hosts

totalTx.label: Total sent
totalTx.tooltip: Sum of traffic across all active VPN interfaces on all servers in the panel
